content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen is solid, but the header stacks a 'Pokličite' button and 'Navodila za pot' link while the hero adds 'Pokličite nas' again, so the call action appears twice within one screen.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works, but the 'Kdaj vas sprejmemo' and 'Kdo vas sprejme' sections leave the right half of the 1280px canvas empty and the page has several dead bands between sections.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Fill the empty right half on desktop: place the team section beside the opening-hours chart or add a photo of the practice/team next to 'Kdo vas sprejme', and tighten vertical padding between sections.","Reduce the repeated 'Pokličite nas' links (hero, strah section, dark CTA, footer) to one strong CTA per screen; on phone drop the header duplicate since the fixed bar already offers call/directions.","Give the hours chart on phone a time axis (7–19 labels) as on desktop so the bars read without guessing, and compress the services list into a two-column or grouped layout to cut its length."],"blockers":[]}
